Input example / variation: PDF with selectable text
What to validate: Native text extraction and field mapping
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Prefer extracted text; do not degrade via unnecessary OCR

Input example / variation: Image-only PDF with no embedded text
What to validate: OCR fallback, page count and confidence
Expected handling / acceptance principle: OCR all relevant pages; low-confidence results go to review

Input example / variation: Smartphone photo of receipt
What to validate: OCR, crop handling and field mapping
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Successful field extraction with source evidence where visible

Input example / variation: Compressed low-resolution receipt
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Low-quality documents flagged, not auto-matched

Input example / variation: iPhone .heic file
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Converted to loss-minimized supported image or explicitly rejected with a clear error

Input example / variation: Word file containing an inserted receipt photograph
What to validate: Extraction of embedded media and page order
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Receipt image extracted/rendered and linked to original filename

Input example / variation: Landscape receipt scanned sideways
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Rotate before OCR; preserve original for audit

Input example / variation: Upside-down scanned receipt
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Normalize orientation or flag for review

Input example / variation: Angled camera photo or curved paper
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Attempt preprocessing but flag persistent unreadability

Input example / variation: Low light, tiny text, glare
Expected handling / acceptance principle: No invented values; request rescan/review when unreadable

Input example / variation: Two receipts on one PDF page or in DOCX
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Create separate linked records for each receipt or send to review

Input example / variation: Receipt across two or more pages
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Do not mix line items or fields from unrelated receipts

Input example / variation: Multiple treatments and subtotals
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Record each relevant line item and total; do not treat subtotal as amount paid

Input example / variation: Handwritten amount, clinic name or date
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Mark uncertain handwritten values for review

Input example / variation: Receipt with mixed languages
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Use declared language support or manual review

Input example / variation: Service date, invoice date and paid date differ
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Service date must not be silently replaced by transaction date

Input example / variation: Clinic name on receipt; practitioner name on claim
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Require corroborating attributes; name similarity alone cannot clear a claim

Input example / variation: Total, tax, discount, insurance coverage, paid amount
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Do not map receipt total to paid amount without evidence

Input example / variation: Same receipt submitted twice in different formats
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Flag likely duplicates; avoid duplicate claims matching

Input example / variation: Malformed PDF, encrypted PDF, unknown extension
Expected handling / acceptance principle: One bad file cannot stop remaining batch; log filename and exception

Input example / variation: Receipt lacks member/customer field
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Never infer absent member identity; route to review

Input example / variation: Two plausible claims with similar amounts/dates
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Ambiguous ties remain manual review; no silent auto-approval

Input example / variation: Names, claim IDs, health information
What to validate: Access control, logging, retention and redaction
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Store only necessary fields and protected evidence; use approved region/host

Input example / variation: Representative 500-file batch
What to validate: Wall time, per-file processing time and restartability
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Finish with no lost files; make reruns idempotent and item-level

Input example / variation: Missing fields, invalid date or bad JSON
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Reject invalid output; include file ID, pages and action decision

Input example / variation: Clear OCR but wrong claim match
Expected handling / acceptance principle: Measure OCR readability, field accuracy and match precision independently
